text: The engagement exists and its systems of record answered
The SOW is filed — everything downstream is derived from it and cannot be invented
Every role Groundwork assigns work to has a named holder
Roles left deliberately unstaffed are recorded with a reason
The Delivery Manager approved the roster
Every feature the SOW commits to is defined at scope level or named out of scope
Every epic traces to something the brief or the SOW commits to
Every epic has a description and a milestone
What the brief leaves unclear is recorded as an open question rather than a guessed epic
The Product Manager approved the epics
Every scope-level feature has a named home in the architecture
